description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thammita, Diulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510076 (23/0348)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership information, and legal status of the properties. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
